name: Paul
note: The apostle, writing from Macedonia after a painful time with the Corinthians.

name: Timothy
note: Named with Paul as co-sender and as one who preached in Corinth (1:1, 1:19).

name: Titus
note: Paul's co-worker, who carried the severe letter and brought back good news; also organizes the collection.

name: The believers in Corinth
note: The church Paul founded, now divided about his authority.

name: The "super-apostles"
note: Outside teachers who questioned Paul's authority and boasted of their credentials.

name: The offender
note: A person who wronged Paul or the church, whom the church disciplined and Paul now asks them to forgive (2:5-11).

name: The Macedonian churches
note: Poor churches such as Philippi and Thessalonica that gave generously.

name: Jesus
note: The crucified and risen Lord whose weakness and power Paul shows.

name: Silvanus
note: Paul's co-worker (Silas), who preached in Corinth with Paul and Timothy (Acts 18:5).
